title: The full tests.py run exceeds the 20 s darwin ceiling on origin/main under host load
goal: A whole-suite tests.py run on a busy darwin host stays under the ceiling in _tools/tests_ceiling.json, or the ceiling reading discounts the wait for the host lock and the load of other sessions: origin/main e826b2fda ran 58 tests in 20.3 s (over the 20 s ceiling) while another session held the host test lock, the longest test (the land e2e) taking about 16 s.
